ctx.x: I wanted to ask, at that particular time you had things that were happening, for instance, like with the Benny Goodman group that was together, that they had also Teddy playing. Also records were being made with people from different orchestras. Did that have anything to do with this? You know, at the time that Teddy had the orchestra and then he just used... men from...?
